integrity: All proof claims and finite checks are included in this standalone package. The primary homotopy reduction and the cycle homotopy theorem are cited prior results. The verifier corroborates finite mod-two Betti numbers, not infinite or integral assertions.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for noniterated generalized Mycielskian independence complexes of wheels W_n with n >= 5, and the single Kronecker double-cover deck action; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Integral homotopy and deck symmetry of wheel Mycielskians
